name: QTerminal
description:
QTerminal is a lightweight, high-performance terminal emulator developed for the LXQt desktop environment. Based on the QTermWidget library, it offers rich customization while maintaining minimal resource usage.

Features:
- Split terminal views horizontally and vertically within the same window
- Multi-tab document support with drag-and-drop tab organization
- Customizable color schemes, font ligatures, and transparency effects
- Search functionality with regular expression highlighting
- Low memory footprint and fast startup times across all desktop environments
